targets.rawSql:
WITH tr AS (
  SELECT CASE '${shift}'
    WHEN 'Current Shift' THEN (SELECT start_time FROM shifts WHERE start_time <= NOW() AND end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1)
    WHEN 'Last Shift' THEN (SELECT start_time FROM shifts WHERE end_time <= NOW() ORDER BY end_time DESC LIMIT 1)
    WHEN 'This Week' THEN date_trunc('week', NOW())
    WHEN 'Last Week' THEN date_trunc('week', NOW()) - INTERVAL '7 days'
    ELSE $__timeFrom()
  END AS t_from,
  CASE '${shift}'
    WHEN 'Current Shift' THEN (SELECT end_time FROM shifts WHERE start_time <= NOW() AND end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1)
    WHEN 'Last Shift' THEN (SELECT end_time FROM shifts WHERE end_time <= NOW() ORDER BY end_time DESC LIMIT 1)
    WHEN 'This Week' THEN NOW()
    WHEN 'Last Week' THEN date_trunc('week', NOW())
    ELSE $__timeTo()
  END AS t_to
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    (get_total_downtime_minutes('${enterprise}','${site}','shopfloor',
      CASE WHEN '${line:raw}' = 'All' THEN '' ELSE '${line:raw}' END, '',
      (SELECT t_from FROM tr), (SELECT t_to FROM tr)) / 60.0 * ${downtime_cost_per_hour})
    +
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(po.quantity_scrap * COALESCE(psc.cost_per_unit, 0)), 0)
     FROM production_orders po
     JOIN asset a ON po.asset_id = a.id
     LEFT JOIN part_scrap_costs psc ON po.part_number = psc.part_number
     WHERE a.enterprise = '${enterprise}' AND a.site = '${site}'
       AND ('${line:raw}' = 'All' OR a.line = '${line:raw}')
       AND po.started_at BETWEEN (SELECT t_from FROM tr) AND (SELECT t_to FROM tr)
       AND po.quantity_scrap > 0)
  ) AS "value"

WITH tr AS (
  SELECT CASE '${shift}'
    WHEN 'Current Shift' THEN (SELECT start_time FROM shifts WHERE start_time <= NOW() AND end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1)
    WHEN 'Last Shift' THEN (SELECT start_time FROM shifts WHERE end_time <= NOW() ORDER BY end_time DESC LIMIT 1)
    WHEN 'This Week' THEN date_trunc('week', NOW())
    WHEN 'Last Week' THEN date_trunc('week', NOW()) - INTERVAL '7 days'
    ELSE $__timeFrom()
  END AS t_from,
  CASE '${shift}'
    WHEN 'Current Shift' THEN (SELECT end_time FROM shifts WHERE start_time <= NOW() AND end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1)
    WHEN 'Last Shift' THEN (SELECT end_time FROM shifts WHERE end_time <= NOW() ORDER BY end_time DESC LIMIT 1)
    WHEN 'This Week' THEN NOW()
    WHEN 'Last Week' THEN date_trunc('week', NOW())
    ELSE $__timeTo()
  END AS t_to
),
downtime_costs AS (
  SELECT
    reason AS "Reason",
    ROUND(duration_mins / 60.0 * ${downtime_cost_per_hour}) AS "€ Impact"
  FROM get_stop_reasons_pareto(
    '${enterprise}','${site}','shopfloor',
    CASE WHEN '${line:raw}' = 'All' THEN '' ELSE '${line:raw}' END, '',
    (SELECT t_from FROM tr), (SELECT t_to FROM tr), 5)
  WHERE category IN ('Unplanned', 'External')
),
scrap_costs AS (
  SELECT
    'Scrap: ' || po.part_number AS "Reason",
    SUM(po.quantity_scrap * COALESCE(psc.cost_per_unit, 0)) AS "€ Impact"
  FROM production_orders po
  JOIN asset a ON po.asset_id = a.id
  LEFT JOIN part_scrap_costs psc ON po.part_number = psc.part_number
  WHERE a.enterprise = '${enterprise}' AND a.site = '${site}'
    AND ('${line:raw}' = 'All' OR a.line = '${line:raw}')
    AND po.started_at BETWEEN (SELECT t_from FROM tr) AND (SELECT t_to FROM tr)
    AND po.quantity_scrap > 0
  GROUP BY po.part_number
)
SELECT * FROM downtime_costs
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM scrap_costs
ORDER BY "€ Impact" DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH tr AS (
  SELECT CASE '${shift}'
    WHEN 'Current Shift' THEN (SELECT start_time FROM shifts WHERE start_time <= NOW() AND end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1)
    WHEN 'Last Shift' THEN (SELECT start_time FROM shifts WHERE end_time <= NOW() ORDER BY end_time DESC LIMIT 1)
    WHEN 'This Week' THEN date_trunc('week', NOW())
    WHEN 'Last Week' THEN date_trunc('week', NOW()) - INTERVAL '7 days'
    ELSE $__timeFrom()
  END AS t_from,
  CASE '${shift}'
    WHEN 'Current Shift' THEN (SELECT end_time FROM shifts WHERE start_time <= NOW() AND end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1)
    WHEN 'Last Shift' THEN (SELECT end_time FROM shifts WHERE end_time <= NOW() ORDER BY end_time DESC LIMIT 1)
    WHEN 'This Week' THEN NOW()
    WHEN 'Last Week' THEN date_trunc('week', NOW())
    ELSE $__timeTo()
  END AS t_to
)
SELECT
  ms.start_time AS "Timestamp",
  a.line AS "Line",
  a.workcell AS "Machine",
  sr.name AS "Reason",
  sr.category AS "Category",
  ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(ms.end_time, NOW()) - ms.start_time)) / 3600
    * ${downtime_cost_per_hour})::integer AS "€ Impact"
FROM machine_stops ms
JOIN asset a ON ms.asset_id = a.id
JOIN stop_reasons sr ON ms.stop_reason_id = sr.id
WHERE a.enterprise = '${enterprise}' AND a.site = '${site}'
  AND ('${line:raw}' = 'All' OR a.line = '${line:raw}')
  AND sr.category IN ('Unplanned', 'External')
  AND ms.start_time BETWEEN (SELECT t_from FROM tr) AND (SELECT t_to FROM tr)

UNION ALL

SELECT
  po.started_at AS "Timestamp",
  a.line AS "Line",
  '' AS "Machine",
  'Scrap: ' || po.part_number AS "Reason",
  'Quality' AS "Category",
  (po.quantity_scrap * COALESCE(psc.cost_per_unit, 0))::integer AS "€ Impact"
FROM production_orders po
JOIN asset a ON po.asset_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN part_scrap_costs psc ON po.part_number = psc.part_number
WHERE a.enterprise = '${enterprise}' AND a.site = '${site}'
  AND ('${line:raw}' = 'All' OR a.line = '${line:raw}')
  AND po.started_at BETWEEN (SELECT t_from FROM tr) AND (SELECT t_to FROM tr)
  AND po.quantity_scrap > 0

ORDER BY "Timestamp" DESC
LIMIT 50
SELECT part_number AS "Part", cost_per_unit AS "€/Unit", description AS "Description" FROM part_scrap_costs ORDER BY part_number
